summary: Clearwater National Forest lookout: a 1919 camp, a 1922 log cabin, then the 1963 R-6 flat cab that stands today and is staffed in fire season.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab on a 12-foot concrete base
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Clearwater National Forest

events.note: Log cabin with cupola built by the Forest Service
R-6 flat cab on a 12-foot concrete base replaced the 1922 cabin
Earliest staff entry on the Idaho site's list
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register
Idaho site lists staffing for 2022 to 2024

corrections.why: The register gives N 46.563060, W 114.442220, and the Forest Association index gives 46.56313, -114.44209. The record point, from an Idaho-site map pin on a road address, is about 19 km away.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the Idaho site describe an R-6 flat cab; the Forest Association index says two-story cab. The story reports both and does not settle it.
The Idaho site (dated July 1, 2025) says staffed every fire season; firelookout.com, which shows no date, says staffed during the summer. Facts use the dated Idaho site.

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts (list compiled June 2016)

notes_for_editor: Location: the record point (46.51124, -114.67897) is an Idaho-site map pin on 'Beaver Ridge Lookout Road', about 19 km from the register and index point. Correction is proposed, not applied. Cab type disagrees: flat cab (register, Idaho site) vs two-story (Forest Association index); story reports both. Staffing: Idaho site says every fire season; firelookout.com says summer. No fire, rental listing or access rules found. Record id ends in -2, so another Beaver Ridge record may exist; not checked. The University of Idaho Keeping Watch page repeats the register coordinates but was not cited.
